description: This file defines exceptions related to the ONNX exporter in PyTorch, including warning and error classes, and specific exceptions for unsupported operators and symbolic value errors.

classes.name: OnnxExporterError
classes.description: Errors raised by the ONNX exporter. This is the base class for all exporter errors.

classes.name: UnsupportedOperatorError
classes.description: Raised when an operator is unsupported by the exporter.

classes.name: SymbolicValueError
classes.description: Errors around TorchScript values and nodes.

methods.name: UnsupportedOperatorError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with a message based on the operator name, version, and supported version.

methods.name: SymbolicValueError.__init__
methods.description: Constructs an error message related to a TorchScript value, including details about the value, its node, inputs, and outputs.
